description: Generic template for creating project documents. Includes document information, document history, table of contents, introduction, purpose, scope, and template history sections for reuse across ASPICE process areas.
Standard template defining the header and footer layout for project documents, including document ID, version, status, author, owner, page numbering, and document link.
Flowchart describing the document lifecycle from Draft to Released, including review, rework, approval, versioning guidelines, and document history maintenance process.
Presentation describing the review workflow, review states, reviewer responsibilities, approval process, rework activities, and release guidelines for project work products.
Guide explaining the end-to-end 360° review process in Polarion, including baseline creation, review task management, reviewer workflow, rework process, and release procedure.
Standard IAST presentation template for creating technical and process-related presentations with a consistent company format and branding.
